newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR soar as spot rates stay firm.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR soar as spot rates stay firm.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were sharply higher on Wednesday as spot rates remained firm amid fresh attack on the peso, traders said.
"People are still wary on the short-term prospects of the interest rates, that's why they're putting a premium on the swap rates," one trader said.
The peso came under speculative selling following a newspaper report of a possible devaluation, which monetary authorities quickly denied.
The vulnerability of the peso fortified traders' fears that the domestic rates would stay high over a long period.
